items.title: Meta Ads: $52.20 spend, 1 lead, $52.20 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: Yesterday (2026-08-31) Meta spent $52.20, all on the only actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 1 lead at $52.20 CPL. Account is ACTIVE, the other three campaigns remain paused, and no ads are flagged.

items.title: Flooring Problems Campaign CPL spiked to $52.20 vs $15.32 baseline
items.summary: Flooring Problems Campaign's CPL yesterday ($52.20/lead on $52.20 spend, 1 lead) ran ~3.4x its 7-day baseline CPL of $15.32/lead ($352.45 / 23 leads over 2026-08-25 to 2026-08-31). Window spend clears the $50 minimum for flagging, but at $52.20 the dollars at stake stay under the $100/day high-priority bar — worth a look if it repeats today.

needs_attention: Flooring Problems Campaign CPL spiked to $52.20/lead yesterday (2026-08-31), ~3.4x the 7-day baseline of $15.32/lead — only 1 lead landed on $52.20 spend. Below the $100/day high-priority bar for now but worth watching if it continues.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 1 yesterday / 23 over the 7-day baseline, matching the counted leads exactly both times). No discrepancy in the counted total, but per the agent's trap note this should be reviewed for whether the script's lead-action set needs extending, not hand-patched here.
